Extract /implement Step 0 bootstrap-invoke wrapper (#3298)

Collapse duplicated Step 0 bootstrap argv assembly, exit-2 operator messaging, and KV parsing into scripts/implement-bootstrap-invoke.sh. SKILL.md calls --mode initial|resume with set +e fences; the wrapper emits bootstrap-routing.env for pre-rehydration routing keys. Includes harness, inverted structure pins, and codex-manifest-schema doc fix.
